description: This file defines UI components and layout functions for Summernote's Bootstrap 4 integration, including creation of editor elements, dialogs, popovers, and toolbar buttons.

methods.name: button
methods.description: Creates a button with optional tooltip and accessibility attributes.

methods.name: toggleBtnActive
methods.description: Sets a button as active or inactive.

methods.name: onDialogShown
methods.description: Registers a handler for when a dialog is shown.

methods.name: onDialogHidden
methods.description: Registers a handler for when a dialog is hidden.

methods.name: createLayout
methods.description: Creates and inserts the editor layout into the DOM.

methods.name: removeLayout
methods.description: Removes the editor layout and restores the original note element.
